say:1:1130519001:0.text: They've been a thorn in the desert's side for quite some time. But when I first came to the Eroded Enclave they were pretty green. Didn't have much of identity back then.
say:1:1130519001:0.source_cn: 知道，他们作乱也不是一天两天了。我很多年前第一次来风蚀...

say:2:1130519002:0.text: The trade routes were much safer then and you could still make a killing flipping ordinary merch.

say:3:1130519003:0.text: But it all went bonkers once news of the treasure hit. I don't know how the Claws did it, but it felt like their numbers exploded overnight.
